rv.q: This latest piece builds on Soleimanpour’s signature style, but the results are uneven – it is an inelegant collision of earnest philosophising intermingled with metatheatrical commentary on the distance between author, actor and audience.
...there's novelty value in these star-studded cold reads
At its best ‘ECHO’ is moving, profound and visually stunning, but it comes saddled with a load of baggage from Soleimanpour being ‘the cold read guy’.
This blend helps make his latest, ECHO (Every Cold-Hearted Oxygen), a uniquely enriching experience.
